label: VERIFIED
extraction: Agent Team Work Zone versioning and release. Deployment rests on bootstrap scripts. Bootstrap step version-checks environment and syncs framework skills and agent definitions into project's .claude/ creating or merging settings rather than overwriting. Framework-owned paths (resources/, docs/, comment-marked blocks of README.md) upgraded on version updates. User-owned paths (projects/, workstations/) preserved across upgrades. Lifecycle on CC >= 2.1.178: <slug>-<role> naming convention lets idle hook derive workstation path from slug prefix without ambiguity; on prior versions hook read it from idle event's team name instead. Related work: AutoGen (Wu et al., 2024), MetaGPT (Hong et al., 2024), AgentVerse (Chen et al., 2024), surveys on agent skills (Yang et al., 2026) and multi-agent systems (Guo et al., 2024). What this work adds: file-based conventions with hooks/scripts/skills for persistence layer without modifying agent algorithms.
